is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae (s.l.), including An. arabiensis, An. coluzzii, and An. gambiae (s.s.) across The Gambia (page 1, Abstract; page 3, 'Species composition and distribution').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for Vgsc-1014F (L995F), Vgsc-1014S (L995S), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) using TaqMan PCR assays (page 3, 'Insecticide susceptibility bioassays of Anopheles gambiae (s.l.)'; page 5, 'Frequency of insecticide resistance molecular markers').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports that 1873 out of 2000 mosquitoes were successfully genotyped, identifies 3 mosquitoes carrying Ace-1 G119S (2 from CRRN and 1 from NBR) (page 5), and reports kdr allele frequencies by species and region in Additional file 1 (Table S4, Table S3).

african_field_population.evidence: Field mosquitoes collected as larvae from natural breeding habitats (or blood-fed/gravid adults) across sentinel sites and villages in The Gambia in 2016 and 2017 and reared to adulthood (page 2, 'Collection and rearing of larvae').

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research article reporting original field collections, WHO bioassays, and molecular marker genotyping conducted in 2016–2017.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data collected from specific sentinel sites and villages (Essau, Farafenni, Mansa Konko, Kuntaur, Brikama, Basse, Bwiam, Pirang, Bakau, Besse, Yallal Ba, Chogen Wellingara, Wali Kunda, Gambisarra, Gunjur Koto, Sare Wuro, Ngedden, Sare Seedy) grouped into 7 regions (page 2, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections took place during the malaria transmission seasons (July–December) of 2016 and 2017 (page 2, 'Collection and rearing of larvae').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected routinely during 2016–2017 across GNMCP sentinel sites; some site locations overlap with previous 2013–2014 survey locations, but these are newly collected specimens.

supplement.evidence: Detailed kdr allele frequencies and sample sizes per species and region live in 'Additional file 1: Table S3, Figure S1, Table S4' and raw bioassay records in 'Additional file 2', which are not included in the main text PDF (page 7, 'Additional files').

assessment.summary: This study monitored insecticide resistance and resistance markers (Vgsc L995F, L995S, and Ace-1 G119S) across 7 regions of The Gambia during the 2016 and 2017 transmission seasons. Out of 2000 sampled An. gambiae s.l. (predominantly An. arabiensis), 1873 were successfully genotyped, revealing strong associations between Vgsc-1014F/S and pyrethroid/DDT survival, and low-frequency detection of Ace-1 119S.
